references.text: Jesus speaks about service and leadership in God's kingdom, and how it differs from worldly rulers.
Jesus repeats the message of service over dominion to his disciples, as he did in Matthew.
Mark gives a parallel account to Matthew about Jesus teaching on service and leadership.
Joseph becomes a ruler in Egypt, but his form of leadership benefits his family and people, which can be seen in contrast to worldly rulers.
Moses warns the people of Israel about kings who will rule over them, reflecting Jesus' warnings against worldly power.
